products.title: Owl Box Project Package: Installation + 5-Year Service Plan
products.body_html:
Support long-term owl conservation with a complete Owl Box Project Package.

Installing an owl box is only the first step. For an owl box to remain safe, suitable and effective for nesting owls, it needs to be serviced annually. This package includes the installation of one owl box, followed by five years of annual servicing by the EcoSolutions team.

Each annual service includes checking the structure and condition of the box, refreshing the nesting substrate, cleaning where needed, treating for bees, checking for signs of owl activity, collecting pellets where available, and carrying out minor maintenance to help keep the box suitable for future breeding seasons.

Package includes:
• 1 owl box installation
• 5 annual owl box services
• Basic maintenance checks
• Nesting substrate refresh
• Bee treatment
• Pellet collection where available
• Occupancy/activity check
• Replacement of the owl box if required

This package is ideal for homes, estates, schools, farms and conservation-minded properties wanting to support practical, long-term owl conservation.

Give the gift of nature this Christmas! 🎄🦉 Our Owl Box Build-It Kits - available in two options: Spotted Eagle Owl box or Barn Owl box- come with everything you need to create a safe, sturdy home for these magnificent birds:

products.title: Rocket Bat Hotel
products.body_html:
Bats are a sort of ‘bug police’: they fly around and catch insects using a process called echolocation to find their insect meals. They make high-pitched sounds that bounce off objects and return to the bat as echoes. Bats in flight can distinguish the difference in sound between a tree, your head, and a mosquito! They reduce pests naturally, reducing the need for pesticide usage and thereby helping to make our water and earth cleaner.

Rocket bat hotels provide suitable roosting and breeding sites for various insect-eating bat species. This bat hotel is mounted on a gum pole and, if possible, close to the water's edge to allow bats to control your insect populations.

Note: These bat boxes can ONLY be installed on a gum pole. The diameter of the gum pole needs to be 75 - 100mm and the height 4.8m (or taller).

Dimensions: 102cm x 30cm x 30cm

Weight: 32kg

products.title: Bats in Your Roof?
products.body_html:
P.O.A

EcoSolutions are able to assist you with the bat exclusion. EcoSolutions undertakes this sort of work across SA and we are the only permitted bat exclusion organisation in the country.  All South African bats are protected by law.

In order to provide you with a quote to exclude your bats, we first need to arrange a site visit. The site visit is undertaken in the evening and includes a consultation with the homeowner, site inspection and a dusk survey.

From the site visit, we will be able to identify the bat species and their IUCN conservation status, determine their entry and egress points, and establish the size of the bat colony and the meterage and materials required. On completion of the consultation, you will receive a comprehensive report detailing the process and the costs.

As stipulated in our permit from GDARD, EcoSolutions will install a bat box on your property to provide compensation for the excluded colony.

products.title: Bush Baby Box
products.body_html:
Bush baby families sleep in nests that are 5-12 meters off the ground. Thick tailed bush baby sleep together during the day but split up at night to forage. They have been found to move up to one kilometre through the night. They live in small groups of 2-6 individuals.

The Bush Baby Box should be installed on a stable branch of a tree at least 5 meters from the ground and within 1-5 meters of any other bush baby boxes that you have acquired. The box can be installed with the use of pre-drilled holes. The boxes can be lined with a small number of sticks and/or straw.

products.title: Junior Scientist Kit
products.body_html:
Where do great scientists come from? They come from great junior scientists! If you are looking for a stocking filler for kids between the ages of 7 - 14. Welcome to our Junior Scientist series. The pellets also come with GPS coordinates which provide their collected location. 

Every Junior Scientist Kit sold goes towards funding Owlproject.org. 

Includes:

  • 2 x Owl Pellets
  • 1 x Petri Dish
  • 1 x Dissection Tweezers
  • 2 x Probes
  • 1 x Face Mask
  • 1 x Pair of Surgical Gloves

Your budding scientists dissect the owl pellets, using their tweezers, probe, petri dish and bone key while wearing their surgical gloves and mask (all provided in the kit). Your Jnr Scientist then sends us a picture via email or WhatsApp of his dissected pellets, accompanied by the coordinates found on the pellet bottle and we will let them know where that particular owl lives. Once the picture of the pellet contents has been taken, everything goes back into the bottle and if there is anything we would like to examine further in the pellet, we will arrange postage or collection.

The Junior Scientist Owl Pellet Kit costs R250.00 and can be collected from our Jo'burg office in Lifestyle Garden Center.

products.title: Spotted Eagle Owl Box
products.body_html:
Welcome to the Urban Owl Box Project!

This box is designed as a breeding box for Spotted Eagle Owls (Bubo africanus). Spotted Eagle Owls occur throughout South Africa and are also our most successful owl box occupants.

Due to the lack of sufficient breeding sites in the urban jungle, owls have a hard time successfully raising chicks. The box provides them with a suitable place to make a nest and a safe place for the chicks to fledge. 

Our owl boxes are constructed from recycled weatherproof plywood and are then sealed with an industrial wood sealant. The thickness of the wood and the wood sealant used, coupled with the annual service, gives the box an outdoor lifespan of four-five years.
